title: Additivity of vector Fourier coefficients
statement: For every natural number $n$, every pair of real-valued functions $f,g$ on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and every $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the vector Fourier coefficient of $f+g$ at $\gamma$ is the sum of the vector Fourier coefficients of $f$ and $g$ at $\gamma$.
